options.map_wide: One setting for the whole map

start_zone_mowing.name: Start zone mowing
start_zone_mowing.description: Start mowing for one or more explicit zone IDs.

zone_ids.name: Zone IDs
zone_ids.description: List of zone IDs to mow, for example [1, 3].

start_edge_mowing.name: Start edge mowing
start_edge_mowing.description: Start mowing the edges for one or more explicit contour IDs.

contour_ids.name: Contour IDs
contour_ids.description: List of contour ID pairs to mow, for example [[1, 0], [2, 0]]. Available contour IDs are exposed in the mower entity's contours attribute once the map has been fetched.

start_spot_mowing.name: Start spot mowing
start_spot_mowing.description: Start mowing for one or more explicit spot area IDs.

spot_area_ids.name: Spot area IDs
spot_area_ids.description: List of spot area IDs to mow, for example [2, 4].

set_cutting_height.name: Set cutting height
set_cutting_height.description: Set the cutting height for a whole map, or for a single zone of it. Not every model supports adjusting the cutting height, and the range depends on the model.

height.name: Cutting height
height.description: Cutting height in centimeters, in steps of 0.5 cm.

map_id.name: Map ID
map_id.description: Map to change. Defaults to the active map. Available map IDs are exposed in the mower entity's maps attribute once the map has been fetched.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to change instead of the whole map. Setting a zone also switches the map to per-zone mowing settings, so the other zones keep their own heights and the map-wide height stops applying. Available zone IDs are exposed in the mower entity's zones attribute.

set_edge_mowing_settings.name: Set edge mowing settings
set_edge_mowing_settings.description: Switch the edge mowing settings for a whole map, or for a single zone of it. Every setting left out keeps the value it has. A map that follows its per-zone settings gets the change written into every zone as well, since the mower no longer reads its map-wide settings. The same settings are available as switch entities for the active map.

automatic_edge_mowing.name: Automatic edge mowing
automatic_edge_mowing.description: Whether the mower mows the edges on its own once all-area or zone mowing has finished.

safe_edge_mowing.name: Safe edge mowing
safe_edge_mowing.description: Whether the mower keeps a small buffer from the lawn boundary while it mows the edges. Not every model offers this setting.

edge_blade_offset.name: Edge blade offset
edge_blade_offset.description: Whether the blade disc shifts to the side for the edge laps so the mower cuts closer to the boundary. Switching this on also raises a single edge lap to two, which the offset disc needs to cover the edge.

map_id.name: Map ID
map_id.description: Map to change. Defaults to the active map. Available map IDs are exposed in the mower entity's maps attribute once the map has been fetched.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to change instead of the whole map. Setting a zone also switches the map to per-zone mowing settings, so the other zones keep their own settings and the map-wide ones stop applying. Available zone IDs are exposed in the mower entity's zones attribute.

set_mowing_direction.name: Set mowing direction
set_mowing_direction.description: Set the direction the mower drives its lanes in for a whole map, or for a single zone of it, and how that direction carries from one session to the next. A map that follows its per-zone settings gets the change written into every zone as well, since the mower no longer reads its map-wide settings. The same settings are available as a number and a select entity for the active map.

angle.name: Angle
angle.description: The direction in degrees, as the app shows it. A direction is a line rather than a heading, so anything from 180 on names the same lanes as the angle half a turn below it.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Whether every session mows in the same direction, or turns against the session before it.

map_id.name: Map ID
map_id.description: Map to change. Defaults to the active map.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to change instead of the whole map. Setting a zone also switches the map to per-zone mowing settings, so the other zones keep their own settings and the map-wide ones stop applying.

set_mowing_preference_mode.name: Set mowing preference mode
set_mowing_preference_mode.description: Choose whether a map applies one set of mowing settings or per-zone settings. Use this to return to a single map-wide cutting height after setting one for an individual zone. The mode covers the other mowing settings too, not only the cutting height.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Whether the map follows its map-wide or its per-zone settings.

map_id.name: Map ID
map_id.description: Map to change. Defaults to the active map.
